status: prototype supports, grille and duct; material, torque, seal and thermal tests are not complete

fan_posts.insert_note: 3 mm length is published. The 3.6 mm body and 3.2 mm pilot are fit allocations to verify on the purchased inserts and a printed coupon. The assembly model leaves room for the installed insert, not the smaller pre-install hole.
fan_posts.screw: M2 x 14, ISO 7045 / DIN 7985H, A2 stainless
fan_posts.assembly_note: Install the inserts in the short floor bosses before fitting the separate tubular spacers. The narrower spacers clear the fan casing; do not replace them with full-width posts. Spacer 2 is 1 mm shorter at the top to seat the one-piece fan-wire brace. Its top remains at the same fan-ear plane.
fan_posts.screw_head_basis: Supplier lists 4.0 mm head diameter and 1.6 mm height. The model reserves 1.8 mm height; exact delivered head and length tolerances need checking.

fin_mounts.spacer_material: machined G10/FR4 candidate; verify the actual material and finished height
fin_mounts.screw: M2 x 8, DIN 965H / ISO 7046-2, A2 stainless
fin_mounts.note: Bottom-access screws engage solid copper tabs, not individual fins. Each screw clamps a 3.6 mm lower insulating spacer, 0.8 mm duct ear and 0.3 mm upper insulating washer. The front floor slot aids assembly alignment; it is not a freely sliding joint after tightening.

intake.seal_material: closed-cell silicone sponge allocation; exact grade and force curve not selected
intake.note: The fan bottom range reserves body, mounting-tab and support-height variation. The seal has 2.0 to 3.4 mm installed space, or 15 to 50 percent compression of a 4 mm sheet. Confirm this range and force with the chosen material.

duct.baffle_material: thin heat-resistant insulating sheet allocation; select and test the actual grade
duct.note: A removable foil bridge seals the short fan-to-baffle gap. The baffle, cowl seams and pipe penetrations need leak testing. The model provides a flow path, not uniform fin flow or a pressure-drop prediction.
duct.retention: Two integral ears share the fin-stack screws and sit between insulating spacers and washers. Printed creep, tab strength and screw torque need a heated sample test.
duct.split_seals: Soft split seals cover the pipe-entry and copper-tab slots after bench assembly. Their displayed holes follow nominal parts; actual compression and adhesive overlaps need qualification.
duct.screw_passage_seals: Applied removable gasket compound fills the clearance between the M2 screws and 2.4 mm duct-ear bores. Material must be noncorrosive and suitable for the measured temperature. Renew after fin screw removal.
